subject: System Design
title: Google's 47-Minute Global Outage
description: A short lesson to help you apply Google's 47-Minute Global Outage.

hook.text: On December 14, 2020, every Google service went dark: Gmail, YouTube, Google Docs — all of them.

buildup.text: Google's internal identity management system ran out of storage quota for authentication tokens.

discovery.text: Without tokens, no user could be authenticated. Every Google service that required login stopped working.

twist.text: The storage quota was set years ago and never updated as usage grew. A ticking time bomb nobody noticed.

climax.text: A forgotten configuration limit brought down the most reliable tech company in the world for 47 minutes.

punchline.text: Even Google can be taken down by a storage limit.

quiz.question: What caused Google's 2020 global outage?
options: The identity system ran out of storage quota for tokens
A power failure at a data center
